quote: the U.S. Trade and Development Agency awarded a technical assistance grant to Guatemala’s National Secretariat of Science and Technology (Senacyt) … Senacyt selected California-based New Sun Road … installation of women-led solar-powered digital community centers (DCCs) in 10 unconnected communities, with the goal of scaling the project to 3,000 sites across rural Guatemala. … The DCCs will be powered by solar panels coupled with battery storage and microgrids
note: Opened USTDA 30 Aug 2023 (New Sun Road Guatemala solar DCC grant).
